rationale: Addressed three feedback items: (1) Removed four prohibited fields from feature_comparison — fraud_pattern_type (label-derived when fraud_label=1) and the protected attributes member_sex, member_race_ethnicity, member_age_band — retaining 14 permitted claim-level and member attributes. (2) Added 'synthetic_data' caveat to disclose that both fraud label and data are synthetic. (3) Added 'no_operational_use' caveat to clarify that results do not support operational fraud decisions. Retained denominators and artifact citations for full transparency.
changes_summary: Removed four leaking/protected fields from feature_comparison (fraud_pattern_type, member_sex, member_race_ethnicity, member_age_band; 18→14 features). Added two caveats to write_report (3→5 total): 'synthetic_data' and 'no_operational_use'.
